summary: Tested new global search feature (GET /api/search + GlobalSearch component on Dashboard). Backend endpoint fully functional; frontend integration works end-to-end: dropdown results, click-through to /equipements opens detail dialog with prefilled search, click-through to /ordres-travail prefills WO search, type/reference queries return correct categories.

issues: When user shortens query to 1 char, previously-shown dropdown remains visible (results not cleared until debounce fires with no fetch). Minor UX.
Recharts warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - pre-existing chart container sizing warnings, not caused by search feature.

action_items: (Optional) Clear GlobalSearch dropdown when query length < 2 to avoid stale results appearing after user shortens input.
(Optional) Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to equipment detail Dialog for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/search uses regex escape and min length 2 — good. Returns _id excluded — good.
Endpoint properly enforces auth (401 without token).
Server.py is large (~4644 lines) - candidate for modularization (not blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: GlobalSearch feature fully verified: /api/search returns proper categorized results; Dashboard search-result-equipment click navigates to /equipements, opens details dialog and prefills search; search-result-work_order click navigates to /ordres-travail with search prefilled; queries by type (Compresseur) and by reference partial work.
